variants.title: Esfera com topo vazado
variants.description: Draw ONLY ONE CENTRAL SPHERE inspired by the central globe in the reference engraving. Ignore the phone screenshot UI, all rings, armillary apparatus, supports, shafts and surrounding frame. NO EXTERNAL RINGS, NO ORBITAL ARCS, NO HALOS, NO PEDESTAL. Antique Renaissance copperplate engraving, precise curved parallel hatching and stippling, crisp pixel-art linework matching Cult of the Sphere. Bone-white / ivory and charcoal on solid pure black #000000, bright upper-left illumination and dense lower-right engraved shadow. Centered game sprite on a 512x512 square, object occupies about 75% of canvas width, generous black margin, fixed three-quarter slightly elevated view. No text, no symbols floating around the object, no modern CGI gloss, no blurry gradients. A HOLLOW SPHERICAL SHELL with its upper cap removed: a wide clearly OPEN circular mouth at the top, visible elliptical cut edge and dark concave inner cavity. Most of the rounded spherical body remains intact below the opening. Thin ivory shell wall visible at the opening, engraved exterior, cross-hatched interior. The opening is a cut into the body itself, NOT a separate ring or attached collar; no floating lid. Preserve the reference globe's fine vertical engraved meridians on the exterior.
variants.visual_review: No external rings, supports or phone UI. Opening clearly visible for variant 1; variants 2 and 3 are closed spheres.
